ओ: ओ The 13th vowel or diphthong of the alphabet, o long.
ओक: ओक (कः) 1. m. A house; a refuge.
ओकस्: ओकस् (कः) 5. n. An asylum; a house.
ओख्: ओख् (ऋ) ओखति 1. a. To be dry; to adorn, to be able, to refuse.
ओघ: ओघ (घः) 1. m. A heap; quick time; a stream; advice; tradition.
ओङ्कार: ओङ्कार (रः) 1. m. The mysterious name of the Trinity; consent, agree-ment; power. f. (रा) Divine energy.
ओज्: ओज् (त् क) ओजयति 10. a. To live.
ओजस्: ओजस् (जः) 5. n. Light; strength; gold; vitality; high style.
ओजायमान: ओजायमान (नः-ना-नं) p. Become strong, bold, heroic.
ओड्र: ओड्र (ड्रः) 1. m. The China rose (Hibiscus mutabilis); north of Orissa.
ओदन: ओदन (नः-नी-नं) m. f. n. Boiled rice. f. A plant, (Sida cordifolia.)
ओम्: ओम् ind. The mystic name of the Deity or Trinity.
ओल: ओल (लः) 1. m. An esculent root. a. Wet, damp.
ओलड: ओलड (इ कि) ओलण्डति, ओलण्डयति 1. 10. a. To dart, to throw up.
ओष्ठरोग: ओष्ठ-रोग (गः) 1. m. Disease of the lip.
ओष्ठावलोप्य: ओष्ठा_वलोप्य (प्यः-प्या-प्यं) a. Luscious, melting in the mouth.
ओष्ठोपमफला: ओष्ठोपम_फला (ला) 1. f. The creeper Bryonia grandis.
